description: This file contains unit tests for the Activation Rebalancer component in an Orleans-based system, focusing on controlling rebalancer operations such as suspend, resume, and report subscription.

classes.name: ControlRebalancerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing control operations of the activation rebalancer, including report subscription and suspend/resume functionality.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: A private inner class implementing IActivationRebalancerReportListener to capture rebalancing reports during tests.

methods.name: Rebalancer_Should_Be_Controllable_And_Report_To_Listeners
methods.description: Test method verifying that the rebalancer can be controlled (suspend/resume) and that reports are correctly received by listeners.

methods.name: OnReport
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a rebalancing report is received, storing the report for assertions.
